published_producer_semantics: Individual-year island table with N_nestlings and N_Recruits outcomes, used by authors' BRMS negative-binomial production model, not a parent-to-offspring pedigree.
encoding: Original producer CSV in Latin1 with 24 header fields but 25 fields per data row because first is R row-index; drop index, do NOT infer ID shift.
join: Unique ID/year/island; natal known from unique nest stage birth year/island in original published presence file. At birth+1 (2007-2014) distinct next-year recorded capt/obs island, immigrant if origin != recorded destination, resident otherwise. No fill-forward, no offspring counts interpreted in v1.233.
guard: All 11 study islands, all years 2007-2014 in producer table, all v1.231 natal known IDs. Report entire crosswalk and duplication counts, no source island selected on favorable outcomes. Any count mismatch or duplicate ID/year/island stops later reproduction interpretation, without altering outcome threshold.
